seed: A logo or a picture comes into a video like any other media (video-title-wt.html, steps 6 to 8: the Library holds svg, png, a logo beside the footage). File > Import Media takes a PNG onto the Library shelf and nowhere else; its tile dragged onto the timeline lands on a track of its own over the recording for five seconds, and dragged onto the picture lands where it is let go with an in and an out; an SVG, which the app cannot keep sharp yet, is refused in words on the shelf and over the canvas, never in silence. At Next defaults, no flag set.

steps.comment: File > Import Media, the mock's Import files row (Shift Command I). The menu bar is frozen under a walk that is not in front, so the command is run directly.

steps.says: Acme Logo.png is in the Library

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: Import Media took a PNG. The logo is a tile on the Library's Media shelf beside the recording, and nothing landed on the timeline or the picture

THE SECOND TEST: the tile let go over the recording two seconds in did not cover it. It landed on a new track over the footage, from 0:02 for five seconds, Premiere's still length, picked and with its own in and out
THE THIRD TEST: undone, then the same tile dragged onto the picture. It lands where it was let go, picked, and runs on the timeline from the playhead with an in and an out

steps.says: Acme Logo.svg can't come in yet. Save it as a PNG

steps.note: THE FOURTH TEST: an SVG let go on the shelf is refused in words that name the move that works, never a drop that does nothing
THE FIFTH TEST: the same SVG held over the picture says why it cannot land, under the pointer, before the button comes up
